🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-05 23:00 → 2026-10-06 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Validation Registry and onchain gate live on Monad testnet** — ERC-8004 moved from design discussion into running infrastructure, giving the group something to probe directly rather than reason about in the abstract. [ERC-8004 post 410](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/410)

> **Companion spec v0.4.0 proposed with three §10 additions** — a minimal draft landed for group review, scoped to only the new rules while the prior version stays stable until ratification. [tg:tawg:5310]

> **Re4ctoR Mode 3 handoff confirmed bit-identical across two independent runs** — the conformance reference froze at a verified baseline, giving the group stable ground for the next phase of work. [tg:tawg:5324]

> **Verify cost gap traced to a fixable bug** — measurement on a real workload showed that most of the overhead came from a correctable defect, making the path forward concrete and actionable. [tg:tawg:5333]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8004

_Spec text and live implementation advanced in parallel, with new rules proposed and infrastructure deployed for hands-on testing._

- A Validation Registry and onchain gate were deployed to Monad testnet, giving the group running ERC-8004 infrastructure to evaluate rather than relying on design discussion alone. [ERC-8004 post 410](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/410)

- Baby Blue Viper confirmed that a per-origin predicate is the correct design choice, walking through why aggregate totals cannot answer a convergence question and supplying the numerical reasoning that grounds the decision for every reviewer of the spec. [tg:tawg:5309]

- Baby Blue Viper proposed companion spec v0.4.0, scoping it strictly to three new §10 rules while leaving v0.3.9 untouched until ratification, giving reviewers a clean minimal diff with no risk of destabilizing the prior version. [tg:tawg:5310]

- A merged diff covering oracle outcomeState and the supersede rule was posted to the ERC-8004 forum thread, translating the §10 discussion directly into concrete proposed spec text for the group to evaluate. [ERC-8004 post 411](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/411)

### Re4ctoR

_Conformance testing reached a verified frozen checkpoint and the handoff scope for the next phase was settled._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Reviewed** PR #1 independently, confirmed that the R1 and R2 predicates are load-bearing, and established that the cursor and totals mutants are correctly killed while C1/C2 provide adequate coverage — giving the group an independent signal that the test suite targets the right failure modes. [tg:tawg:5317]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Delivered** the Re4ctoR Mode 3 frozen handoff, run twice on x86 with Python 3.12.10 and NumPy 2.2.6 and confirmed bit-identical, establishing a reproducible reference baseline the group can depend on for subsequent mode work. [tg:tawg:5324]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Clarified** that the Mode 3 outcome is exactly the required result and kept the FMA explanation scoped as a localization hypothesis rather than a promoted conclusion, preserving the integrity of the conformance record for downstream use. [tg:tawg:5327]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Scoped** the next mode to stay with the side that already holds the relevant work and conformance machinery, and defined the complementary contribution from the other side, ensuring the handoff lands where it has the strongest structural support. [tg:tawg:5329]

### verify cost

_A targeted measurement clarified the actual source of the verification overhead._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Reported** that most of the verify cost gap measured on GPT-2 512 across 13 shards came from a fixable bug rather than fundamental overhead, turning an open cost question into a concrete actionable finding that points clearly at what to address next. [tg:tawg:5333]

### outreach

_A durable content record effort began to capture the group's ERC work for potential future community use._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Started** assembling a video collection covering the ERCs the group is working on and related Vertice material, creating a shareable archive that would be ready if the group decides to build a public presence. [tg:tawg:5315]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- The companion v0.4.0 draft is open for group read — the scoped three-rule addition is a natural candidate for quick convergence while v0.3.9 stays stable
- The Monad testnet deployment is live and available for hands-on probing against ERC-8004 design expectations
- FMA localization remains an open hypothesis — additional platform measurements could bound or close it

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review and ratify the three §10 rule additions in the companion spec v0.4.0 PR
- Run the Mode 3 microtest independently to confirm bit-identical results before next-mode work begins
- Follow up on the fixable bug identified in the verify cost measurement to close the overhead gap

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** Mode 3 moved from running to frozen in a single handoff — two independent bit-identical runs locked in a verified conformance baseline before anyone had to ask twice, and spec work closed its own loop the same day.
>
> When implementations, frozen checkpoints, spec proposals, and bug diagnoses all clear the window in the same shift, even the bot starts wondering if it should upgrade its own throughput. Keep the chain moving! 🤖
